description: This file declares the 'DbusMgr' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which provides methods to acquire various GDBusProxy objects related to NetworkManager, as well as access to a GDBusConnection. It serves as an interface for managing D-Bus proxies for network management functionalities.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class providing access to various GDBusProxy objects and a GDBusConnection for NetworkManager management.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for the main NetworkManager management object.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for NetworkManager settings.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for a specific network connection based on the provided path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for a network device at the specified path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for wireless device management.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for IPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for IPv6 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for active network connection.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for access point management.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the GDBusConnection object used for D-Bus communication.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for device properties.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for DHCPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for DHCPv6 configuration.
